notes.title: 🚀 Launch Incoming: Sex Wish Lands April 10!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’ve got exciting news — I Wish officially launches on April 10, and I couldn’t be more excited to share it with you.

If you haven’t played the (free) demo yet, now’s the perfect time. It’s a great taste of what’s to come — and a chance to get familiar with the world, tone, and characters before the full game drops.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412680/Sex_Wish_A_Deliciously_Naughty_Porn_VN/][h2]👉 Play the Demo Now[/h2]
[/url]

✨ What’s New in the Full Version?

The full game goes far beyond what you’ve seen so far in the demo. It includes:

[list]
[*] A deeper, more complex story with multiple paths
[*] Spicy and surprising new characters
[*] A few twists you won’t see coming 👀
[/list]
And just for you — here’s a sneak peek at Wendy and Stacey, a mother and daughter who don’t appear in the demo:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45373967/d0b0b63ff7487414e722b1c3febc02158477d5e7.jpg[/img]

Though they only play a small part in the story, it's one of my favorite parts, and I can’t wait for you to meet them.

See you on launch day!
